# Wikipedia

> Wikipedia is a free online encyclopedia, created and edited by volunteers around the world and hosted by the Wikimedia Foundation.

Wikipedia provides collaboratively written reference content across millions of articles, plus community policies, editing help, portals, and project coordination pages on the Wikimedia platform.

## Main Encyclopedia
- [Wikipedia Home](https://www.wikipedia.org/): Language gateway to Wikipedia and related Wikimedia projects.
- [English Wikipedia Main Page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page): Main entry point to the English-language encyclopedia.
- [Contents](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents): Structured directory of encyclopedia topics, lists, and reference pages.
- [Featured Content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Featured_content): Showcase of Wikipedia's highest-quality articles, lists, pictures, and portals.
- [Current Events](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Current_events): Daily summaries of notable world events with encyclopedia links.
- [Random Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Random): Opens a randomly selected encyclopedia article.
- [Categories](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Categories): Browse the encyclopedia's category system alphabetically.
- [All Pages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:AllPages): Alphabetical index of all page titles on English Wikipedia.

## Reader Tools
- [Search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search): Search for articles, categories, templates, and project pages.
- [Recent Changes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Live feed of edits across English Wikipedia.
- [New Pages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:NewPages): List of recently created encyclopedia pages.
- [Page Information](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help:Page_information): Help page explaining article metadata and page statistics.
- [Download as PDF](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Download_as_PDF): Instructions for exporting Wikipedia content as PDF.
- [Book Creator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Books): Help for compiling multiple pages into downloadable collections.

## Editing Help
- [Introduction to Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Introduction): Beginner-friendly overview of how Wikipedia works.
- [Tutorial](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Tutorial): Step-by-step guide to basic Wikipedia editing.
- [VisualEditor User Guide](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:VisualEditor/User_guide): Documentation for editing with Wikipedia's visual editor.
- [Referencing for Beginners](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Referencing_for_beginners): Practical guide to adding citations and references.
- [Your First Article](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Help:Your_first_article): Guidance for drafting and submitting a new article.
- [Teahouse](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Teahouse): Friendly help forum for new and inexperienced editors.
- [Help Desk](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Help_desk): Community question-and-answer page for editing and usage help.
- [Manual of Style](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Manual_of_Style): Core style guidance for writing and formatting articles.

## Policies and Guidelines
- [Five Pillars](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Five_pillars): Fundamental principles that define Wikipedia's mission and norms.
- [Neutral Point of View](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Neutral_point_of_view): Policy requiring articles to be written fairly and without bias.
- [Verifiability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Verifiability): Policy requiring material to be attributable to reliable published sources.
- [No Original Research](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:No_original_research): Policy prohibiting unpublished analysis, synthesis, and novel claims.
- [Notability](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Notability): Guideline for determining whether a topic merits its own article.
- [Reliable Sources](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Reliable_sources): Guidance on evaluating source quality and suitability.
- [Conflict of Interest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Conflict_of_interest): Guidance for editors with personal or financial connections to topics.
- [Biographies of Living Persons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Biographies_of_living_persons): Strict sourcing and content rules for living people.

## Community and Governance
- [Community Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Community_portal): Central hub for discussions, tasks, and collaboration.
- [Village Pump](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Village_pump): Main discussion area for policy, technical, and community matters.
- [WikiProjects Directory](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:WikiProject_Council/Directory): Directory of subject-focused editor collaboration groups.
- [Administrators' Noticeboard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Administrators%27_noticeboard): Forum for administrative issues and requests.
- [Arbitration Committee](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Arbitration_Committee): Information about Wikipedia's highest dispute-resolution body.
- [Requests for Comment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requests_for_comment): Structured venue for wider community input on disputes and proposals.
- [Requested Articles](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requested_articles): Community-maintained lists of notable missing topics.
- [Requested Moves](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Requested_moves): Discussions about renaming article and project pages.

## Content Portals and Topic Navigation
- [Portals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contents/Portals): Directory of topic portals for broad subject exploration.
- [Arts Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Arts): Entry point for articles related to art, literature, music, and culture.
- [History Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:History): Topic portal for historical periods, events, and figures.
- [Science Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Science): Portal covering scientific disciplines, concepts, and discoveries.
- [Technology Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Technology): Portal for engineering, computing, and applied technology topics.
- [Geography Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Geography): Portal for places, regions, maps, and geographic concepts.
- [Biography Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Biography): Portal for articles about notable people across fields.
- [Mathematics Portal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portal:Mathematics): Portal for mathematical topics, concepts, and biographies.

## Data, APIs, and Reuse
- [Wikipedia API Help](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:API): Overview of APIs and programmatic access related to Wikipedia.
- [MediaWiki Action API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page): Main reference for the MediaWiki Action API used by Wikipedia.
- [REST API](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:REST_API): Documentation for MediaWiki's REST-based endpoints.
- [API Sandbox](https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:ApiSandbox): Interactive tool for testing MediaWiki API requests.
- [Database Download](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Database_download): Information about downloading Wikipedia data dumps.
- [Data Dumps](https://dumps.wikimedia.org/): Public Wikimedia dump files for Wikipedia and sister projects.
- [Reusing Wikipedia Content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Reusing_Wikipedia_content): Licensing and attribution guidance for content reuse.
- [Citing Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Citing_Wikipedia): Guidance on citing Wikipedia and generating article citations.

## Wikimedia Foundation and Movement
- [Wikimedia Foundation](https://wikimediafoundation.org/): Nonprofit organization that hosts Wikipedia and related projects.
- [About Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:About): Overview of Wikipedia's purpose, scope, and community model.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:FAQ): Answers to common questions about using and editing Wikipedia.
- [Contact Us](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Contact_us): Contact options for readers, editors, and organizations.
- [Donate](https://donate.wikimedia.org/): Support Wikipedia and Wikimedia with financial contributions.
- [Wikimedia Projects](https://www.wikimedia.org/): Directory of Wikipedia's sister projects and movement sites.
- [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/): Shared media repository used across Wikipedia and Wikimedia projects.
- [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/): Structured linked-data project supporting Wikipedia and other Wikimedia sites.

## News and Outreach
- [Wikipedia Signpost](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikipedia_Signpost): Community newspaper covering Wikimedia news, analysis, and commentary.
- [Wikipedia Blog Tag](https://diff.wikimedia.org/tag/wikipedia/): Wikimedia Diff posts related to Wikipedia news and initiatives.
- [Press Room](https://wikimediafoundation.org/about/press/): Wikimedia Foundation press releases, statements, and media resources.
- [Research Newsletter](https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Research:Newsletter): Updates on Wikimedia research, studies, and findings.
- [Outreach Dashboard](https://outreachdashboard.wmflabs.org/): Tool for tracking education, edit-a-thon, and outreach programs.
- [Education Program](https://outreach.wikimedia.org/wiki/Education): Information about using Wikipedia in teaching and learning contexts.
